svg.text: 1 · The master strip is the sub-page's summary band: one row on a desk, two rows on a phone. It never sits beside the sounds.
2 · Upload is the page's action band, above the collection: one button and a drop area across the content's width.
3 · The sounds are one auto-fill grid of cards at least 18 rem wide: 3 columns at 1280 px, 5 at 1920 px, 1 on a phone. Three sounds keep their card width; they never stretch across the page.
4 · Order: A to Z by name, whatever the source. An upload lands at its place in that order; nothing else moves. A sound's warning is a line on its card, and rows stay level.
